title: A Sketchbook on the Train
story: Leo used the evening train to fill a page of his sketchbook, drawing the station roof before the carriage moved. A passenger beside him asked whether the picture was for a class. Leo said it was only practice, though he hoped to enter a small exhibition in spring. He added the date and closed the book when his stop was announced.

vocabulary.definition: A book of plain pages used for drawing.
One of the connected sections of a train.
A person travelling in a vehicle who is not driving it.
Repeated work done in order to improve.
Said publicly so that people will hear.

quiz.question: What did Leo draw before the train moved?
options: The station roof
The passenger beside him
A poster for the spring show
A map of the stops
quiz.explanation: He drew the station roof before the carriage moved.
quiz.supportingSentence: Leo used the evening train to fill a page of his sketchbook, drawing the station roof before the carriage moved.

quiz.question: What does Leo’s hope suggest about these drawings?
options: He may one day show work like this in public
He plans to stop drawing after this journey
He is teaching the passenger to draw
He needs the date for a ticket refund
quiz.correctAnswer: He may one day show work like this in public
quiz.explanation: Hoping to enter an exhibition means he may show drawings publicly in spring.
quiz.supportingSentence: Leo said it was only practice, though he hoped to enter a small exhibition in spring.

quiz.question: Why did Leo close the sketchbook when he did?
options: His stop had been called, so he needed to get ready
The passenger told him to stop drawing
The exhibition had already closed
The station roof was too dark to see
quiz.correctAnswer: His stop had been called, so he needed to get ready
quiz.explanation: He closed the book when his stop was announced, which is the moment to prepare to get off.
quiz.supportingSentence: He added the date and closed the book when his stop was announced.

quiz.question: What does exhibition mean in this story?
options: A public show of art
A daily train journey
A page in a sketchbook
A spoken station message
quiz.explanation: Leo hopes to enter an exhibition, meaning a show where art is displayed.
quiz.supportingSentence: Leo said it was only practice, though he hoped to enter a small exhibition in spring.

quiz.question: Why did Leo use the evening train in this way?
options: He wanted the journey time for drawing
He wanted to change his stop
He wanted to sell the sketchbook
He wanted a lesson from the passenger
quiz.correctAnswer: He wanted the journey time for drawing
quiz.explanation: He used the evening train to fill a page of his sketchbook.
quiz.supportingSentence: Leo used the evening train to fill a page of his sketchbook, drawing the station roof before the carriage moved.
